notes: Off-script layout. kolabing-v2 has no JS/TS component library, no Storybook and no dist/, so the standard converter (package-build.mjs) does not apply and neither the package nor the storybook shape can run. This sync ships brand foundations only: tokens, self-hosted fonts, guidelines and rendered preview sheets — no _ds_bundle.js and no components/. _ds_sync.json is deliberately omitted: there is no component render-hash recipe to anchor, so every re-sync re-derives from source. See .design-sync/NOTES.md.
